title: Festnahme nach Fahrzeugdiebstahl, verbotenem Kraftfahrzeugrennen und mehreren Verkehrsdelikten

extraction.summaryEn: A 35-year-old man stole a running delivery van in Köpenick and fled at high speed, causing several crashes and injuring a cyclist. Police fired two shots at the vehicle during his arrest at the stadium car park, and an officer was hurt.
